claims: Luka Dončić suffered a left hamstring injury during the third quarter of the Los Angeles Lakers' game against the Oklahoma City Thunder on April 2, 2026.
Luka Dončić was ruled out for the remainder of the game.
Luka Dončić limped off the court after appearing to tweak the muscle while driving to the basket.
The injury is a left hamstring strain or tweak.
The incident occurred with 7:39 remaining in the 3rd quarter.
Luka Dončić appeared to struggle with the hamstring injury earlier in the half.
Luka Dončić is scheduled to undergo an MRI to determine the severity.
The injury occurred during a 139-96 loss to the Oklahoma City Thunder.
Luka Dončić hinted at hamstring issues earlier in the game before needing to leave the floor, according to ESPN and YouTube reports.
